title: ATLANTIK CORAZON FESTIVAL 2027 ❤️ OCEAN KIZOMBA BEACH SALSA BACHATA
description:
🌊 𝗔𝗧𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗧𝗜𝗞 𝗖𝗢𝗥𝗔𝗭𝗢𝗡 𝗙𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗩𝗔𝗟 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳 ❤️ 𝗢𝗖𝗘𝗔𝗡 𝗞𝗜𝗭𝗢𝗠𝗕𝗔 – 𝗕𝗘𝗔𝗖𝗛 𝗦𝗔𝗟𝗦𝗔 / 𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗻𝘁-𝗡𝗮𝘇𝗮𝗶𝗿𝗲, 𝗙𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 – 𝗔𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗹 𝟮𝟮 𝘁𝗼 𝟮𝟲, 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳
=== Français ci-dessous
〰️ 𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐣𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐚𝐥𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕 !
Spectacular, by the sea, inside the gigantic historic submarine base transformed into an incredible dance venue, come and experience a moment filled with humanity, talent, and joy.
〰️A dream line-up featuring international teachers and DJs.
✈️Airport-to-festival shuttles, hotels located just opposite the venue.
🔊Exceptional sound system (Line Array), concert lighting, giant LED screens, and breathtaking dance halls.
〰️ A program of four unforgettable days:
– More than 43 hours of classes with teachers from all over Europe
– 3 major parties – one Kizomba room and one Salsa / Bachata room
– Social dancing with sea views
– A pre-party in a magical venue (not included in the full pass)
– A beach party at the famous Place du Commando
– A memorable flashmob
– Shows and showcases without disrupting the dancing
——————————————————————————

——————————————————————————
𝐓𝐎𝐏 𝐐𝐔𝐀𝐋𝐈𝐓𝐘 & 𝐀𝐅𝐅𝐎𝐑𝐃𝐀𝐁𝐋𝐄 𝐏𝐑𝐈𝐂𝐄𝐒
La Case Corazon promotes the artistic and human values of Afro-Latin dances and music.
This festival is a tribute to human and artistic talent through a unique program.
In an outstanding touristic setting (the Ocean, La Baule, Pornichet, Guérande…), let’s dance and share pleasure and emotions together.
